_meta.universe: Nifty 500 (NSE constituent list); Nifty 200 members flagged
_meta.industry: AMFI industry classification, from an index fund's 30 Sep 2026 portfolio

basis.company: Estimated from the company's annual report and segment disclosures (Risk Radar curated map). 'share' = share of the cost base; 'rev' = share of revenue from selling that commodity. Estimates, labelled as such.
basis.sector: Exposures typical of the company's AMFI industry. Not company-specific: a level (high / medium / low), not a measured share.

_meta.not_advice: Information only. No buy, sell or hold views, no price targets.

crude.note: Includes crude-derived inputs: fuels, plastics, petrochemicals, carbon black, synthetic rubber.

gas.note: Series is US Henry Hub. India's LNG is partly oil-indexed and partly priced off Asian spot (JKM), so read moves with care.

coal.note: Thermal coal series. Coking coal (steel) moves on its own curve and has no free series.

steel.note: Iron ore used as the closest free series for the steel chain. Indian steel prices also move on domestic demand and duties.

gold.note: In India the landed price also includes import duty (15% since 13 May 2026).

edoil.note: Palm oil series; soy and sunflower oil usually move with it.

sugar.note: Indian sugar prices are largely set by policy (MSP, export quotas, ethanol diversion), not by the world price.

grains.note: India's wheat market is closed to exports; domestic prices follow procurement policy more than world prices.

usd.note: A rise in USD/INR means a weaker rupee: it helps companies earning in dollars and hurts those paying in dollars.

rates.note: No rate series in the feed yet; what-if only.

power.note: Indian grid is ~70% coal-fired; no free industrial-tariff series.

other.note: Inputs with no free price series: APIs from China, chips, lithium, titanium dioxide, palladium, cotton, pulp and others.
